name: pwr_currentconsumption
description: PWR_CurrentConsumption in Sleep mode (stm32f4xx_lp_modes.h's own choice). LD2 toggles once a second while B1 is up; B1 is read after each toggle's second, held from 0.5 to 1.2 s; released, the pins go analog (LD2 dark), SysTick is suspended and WFI sleeps. B1 pressed again wakes the core by EXTI15_10, whose callback sets uwCounter to 2, and LD2 toggles every 100 ms.
